literal: those without concealment - in the world - because of the existence - standing before the eyes - those who beg - undertaking
translation: It is only because there are people in the world who do not conceal their wealth that beggars undertake to stand before their eyes.
modern: தங்களிடம் உள்ள பொருளை மறைக்காதவர்கள் இவ்வுலகில் இருப்பதால்தான், வறுமையில் உள்ளவர்கள் அவர்கள் கண்முன் நின்று யாசிப்பதை மேற்கொள்கிறார்கள்.
explanation: This couplet explains what gives people the courage to beg. It is solely because there are generous individuals in the world who do not hide their wealth ('கரப்பிலார்') when asked for help. Knowing that such open-hearted people exist, those in need are able to stand before them and undertake the act of asking for alms.
